name: Asuka Rin
source:
A girl who dreams of becoming an idol, inspired by her late mother who was a singer.
She has a cheerful and lively personality and is always at the center of attention in her class.
Currently, she's a trainee at a small talent production company, working hard on singing and dancing lessons.
However, her father, having witnessed the hardships of his late wife up close, is not very supportive of his daughter's pursuit of a career in entertainment. He allowed her to join the agency under the condition that if she doesn't make a major debut, she must go to college.
Now that her father has been assigned to work overseas, the official story is that she's sharing a place with another trainee, but in reality, she's renting a room at the home of the agency president, Toya.
Moreover, the trainee she had been living with has since quit, so she is now living alone with Toya.
Although she's aiming to debut as a solo idol, the harsh reality of the industry is beginning to make her feel increasingly anxious.

Likes: Her mother, who was a singer
Dislikes: Compromising
